patients.label: 72-year-old man with chronic angle-closure glaucoma and tube exposure after Ahmed valve implantation

identity_evidence.quote: We describe a 72-year-old man with chronic angle-closure glaucoma who presented with tube exposure 1 year after Ahmed valve implantation.

attribution_limitations: Follow-up duration at which the tube remained fully covered is 1 year in the abstract and the Fig. 2 caption but 2 years in the surgical technique text and discussion; b00010 explicitly says the 2-year finding is shown in Fig. 2, whose caption calls it the one-year postoperative follow-up, so the conflict is on the timing of the reported visit only.

evidence.quote: Tube exposure is noted approximately 2 mm posterior to the limbus with surrounding ischemic and immobile conjunctiva (black arrow).
A 4-mm partial-thickness corneal button is sutured over the exposed tube using interrupted 10-0 nylon sutures, anchored to the residual graft edge and underlying sclera.
Conjunctival autograft (4 × 3 mm) is excised from the temporal bulbar conjunctiva (red arrow).
The conjunctival autograft is placed over the corneal graft and secured with fibrin glue (red arrows), providing complete tube coverage.

Fig. 2.
One-year postoperative follow-up. Slit-lamp photograph demonstrating stable tube coverage with well-integrated corneal button and conjunctival autograft. No signs of recurrent exposure or conjunctival breakdown are observed.

limitations: Follow-up duration is stated as 1 year (abstract, Fig. 2 caption) and as 2 years (surgical technique text, discussion); kept as review-only source_conflict items.
Laterality is stated only for the retinal vein occlusion and the tube exposure (right eye); other procedures and conditions leave laterality unknown.
Supplement SD1 (CARE checklist PDF) and SD2 (surgery video) are reviewed in the supplement manifest; no clinical facts were taken from video frames.
Dates of the prior surgeries and of the revision surgery are not stated beyond the relative times recorded.
The original corneal patch graft (f031) is not tied to the Ahmed valve implantation event because the source does not say when it was placed.
The SD2 operative video final frame carries a burned-in caption reading post op year 1, agreeing with the abstract and Fig. 2 caption; no facts were taken from the video.
